note: One entry per entity fact the register consumes. The required set is derived from the predicates at load time; this file supplies the question a reviewer is actually asked. A derived field with no entry here fails the build, and an entry here with no consumer fails too, so the questionnaire cannot drift from the register.

fields.question: Which entity classes describe this entity? Select every class that applies; parent classes are added automatically.
fields.help: A river authority created under art. XVI sec. 59 and governed by Water Code ch. 49 is both DISTRICT_ART3_52B_ART16_59 and WATER_DISTRICT_36_49. Getting this wrong changes which training and audit controls apply.

fields.question: Does the entity invest funds, as opposed to holding them only in deposit accounts?
Are all funds held solely in interest-bearing deposit accounts or in certificates of deposit under Sec. 2256.010?
fields.help: This is the deposit-only carve-out from the biennial training requirement. It is narrower than it sounds: authorizing Treasuries defeats it.

fields.question: Does the school district file the annual sworn affidavit required to claim the Sec. 2256.008(g) training exemption?
fields.help: Without the affidavit the exemption does not attach, whatever the deposit position.

fields.question: Has the entity contracted with a registered investment management firm under Sec. 2256.003(b)?
Are the entity's funds invested by another investing entity under contract?
How many full-time employees does the entity have?
fields.help: Only the fewer-than-five threshold matters, and only for a 52(b)/59 district with a management contract.

fields.question: Does the entity maintain one or more pooled fund groups?
fields.help: Sec. 2256.002(9): an internally created fund in which one or more institutional accounts are invested. An entity holding only separately invested assets is outside the dollar-weighted average maturity requirement.

fields.question: Is an officer of the entity assigned the function of investing its funds by law, rather than by designation of the governing body?
For a state agency: are the assets in question invested by the comptroller under Sec. 404.024?
For an institution of higher education: what was the book value of its endowment funds on 1 September 2017?
fields.help: At or above $150,000,000 the institution falls outside Subchapter A entirely. Enter 0 for entities with no endowment.

fields.question: Is the entity a public retirement system as defined by Sec. 802.001?
Are these state funds invested by the comptroller?
Are these funds managed by the Veterans' Land Board under Natural Resources Code ch. 161, 162 or 164?
Are these registry funds deposited under Local Government Code ch. 117?
Are these funds held in a 401(k) or 457 deferred compensation plan not subject to Subchapter A?
What is the principal amount of the entity's outstanding long-term indebtedness, plus any long-term indebtedness proposed to be issued?
fields.help: At or above $250,000,000, and with the rating test below satisfied, the entity is an eligible entity for hedging transactions under Sec. 2256.0206. Enter 0 if the entity has no long-term debt.

fields.question: Is the entity's outstanding long-term indebtedness rated in one of the four highest long-term rating categories by a nationally recognized municipal rating agency?
fields.help: Judged without regard to any credit agreement or credit enhancement entered into in connection with the obligation.
